<sub>private route · personal runtime · public shell</sub>

<br>

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  session: wayx                              │
```

---

```console
$ whoami
chance

$ cat /etc/wayx
A private workspace built for my own convenience.

$ purpose
personal use only

$ public_documentation
permission denied
```

WayX exists primarily as a **personal workspace**.

It is not intended to be a product, a service, a tutorial, or a complete public distribution.  
Most implementation details, internal structure, usage notes, and working context are intentionally left undocumented here.

> **Less documentation. Less noise. Less surface area.**
